text: At its meetings on May 22 and September 16, 2019, Toronto and East York Community Council directed Transportation Services to study strategies to improve safety at the Gerrard Street East and Pembroke Street intersection. This report provides an overview of the safety review and safety improvements undertaken by Transportation Services.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Received the report (November 7, 2019) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services for information.
